justification: Line 12 incorrectly uses the signed expectation E[X_n] to bound the tail of |X_n|; the required nonnegative quantity would be |X_n| and its expectation is not controlled by the hypothesis. On the two-point probability space with equal probabilities, let X_n equal 1 on one point and -1 on the other for every n. Then E[X_n] = 0 for every n, but P(|X_n| > 1/2) = 1 for every n, which both violates line 12 and refutes the exact convergence conclusion.
